로컬 노드에서만 cluster_config CLI를 실행합니다. insert 적용 시 시간 서버 설정도 함께 적용합니다.

target.description: 수정 대상 호스트 IP 또는 식별자

destroy.description: stop action에서 virsh shutdown 대신 destroy를 사용할지 여부

disk.description: optional GFS disk path override for reset action

purge.description: delete action에서 CCVM 이미지까지 삭제할지 여부

resource.description: PCS resource name. 비어 있으면 cloudcenter_res를 사용한다.

time.description: cluster token time for sync action

xml.description: CCVM libvirt XML path for create action

snap_name.description: snapshot name for rollback, or optional custom name for backup

deleted_snapshots.description: backup 후 보관 정책으로 삭제한 snapshot 이름 목록

snap_name.description: 생성 또는 복구 대상 snapshot 이름

target.description: 실제 작업을 수행한 대상 ablecube IP 또는 식별자

gfs_mount_point.description: GFS mount point. ablestack-vm에서 ccvm.qcow2 경로 계산에 사용한다.

disk.description: comma separated disk list for legacy clients

pv_name.description: comma separated PV names for delete-clvm

vg_name.description: comma separated VG names for delete-clvm

target.description: target role or direct target IP: ccvm/scvm/10.10.31.10

hostname.description: role display name. host uses hosts[].hostname, scvm uses scvm+index, ccvm uses ccvm.

checkOption.description: checkOption: r for backup schedule, d for delete schedule

delete.description: delete old backup mtime days

timeone.description: timeone: at schedule text for repeat=no, HH:mm for repeat jobs

timetwo.description: timetwo: weekday(0-6) for weekly, month interval-day for monthly such as 1-15

ccvm_lifecycle.description: optional CCVM lifecycle request. Defaults to setup when ccvm_xml is provided.

cluster.description: cluster apply request. If omitted, cluster_apply is skipped unless explicitly selected.

force_reset.description: allow reset/destructive future steps. Current implementation does not run destructive reset by default.

gfs.description: GFS/PCS storage request for VM/HCI filesystem flows.

license_content.description: license file content (base64). If empty, current local license is reused by license_apply.

license_filename.description: license filename used when saving on targets.

licenses.description: host-specific license content keyed by hostname, ablecube IP, index, or scvmN name.

local.description: local storage request for standalone flows.

mode.description: mode: all/partial. all is the default.

scvm_by_host.description: host-specific SCVM XML requests keyed by hostname, ablecube IP, index, or scvmN name.

update_system_profile.description: update systemProfile flags for successfully executed steps. Defaults to true.

pkname.description: 내부 트리 재구성에만 쓰고, 최종 응답에서는 제거합니다.

disk.description: comma separated disk list for legacy clients

lv_name.description: logical volume name for single VG requests

non_stop_check.description: set PCS maintenance-mode around extend operations

use_lvmlockd.description: enable or disable lvmlockd and devicesfile in lvm.conf. nil defaults to true for modify-lvm-conf.

vg_name.description: volume group name for single VG requests

message.example: Glue Config All cube host and scvm update Success

filename.description: license filename used when saving on targets

license_content.description: license file content (base64). If empty for register, current local license is reused.

licenses.description: host-specific license content keyed by hostname, role name, target IP, index, or scvmN name.

roles.description: target roles: ablecube/scvm/ccvm/all. Defaults to ablecube for backward compatibility.

target_hostnames.description: explicit target hostnames from cluster.json hosts[].hostname. ccvm can be selected with "ccvm".

targets.description: explicit target IPs. If set, roles are ignored.

disk.description: comma separated disk list for legacy clients

image_name.description: delete action에서 삭제할 이미지명. 콤마 구분 또는 /dev/rbd/rbd/gfs07 경로 허용

image_prefix.description: create action 이미지 prefix. 비어 있으면 gfs

images.description: image name list. 원격 rbdmap 반영 내부 호출에도 사용한다.

pool_name.description: RBD pool name. 비어 있으면 rbd

size.description: create action에서 생성할 전체 용량 GiB

target.description: target ablecube host IP. 비어 있으면 요청을 받은 노드에서 실행한다.

target_hostname.description: target hostname. target이 비어 있을 때 cluster.json hosts[].hostname으로 ablecube를 찾는다.

replication_network_bridge.description: replication network bridge for bridge mode

replication_nic_passthrough.description: replication network PCI ID for nic_passthrough

replication_nic_passthrough_bonding_list.description: replication network PCI IDs for nic_passthrough_bonding

server_network_bridge.description: server network bridge for bridge mode

server_nic_passthrough.description: server network PCI ID for nic_passthrough

server_nic_passthrough_bonding_list.description: server network PCI IDs for nic_passthrough_bonding

bits.description: generate 액션에서 사용할 RSA key bit 수. 비어 있으면 4096을 사용한다.

overwrite.description: 기존 파일이 있으면 덮어쓴다. 기본값은 true다.

dry_run.description: true면 실제 실행하지 않고 명령만 반환한다.

json.description: cluster.json path. 비어 있으면 기본 cluster.json을 사용한다.

local.description: update_json_file 사용 시 현재 호스트에서만 JSON을 업데이트한다.

new_port.description: 변경할 SSH 포트. 지정하지 않으면 -P 없이 실행한다.

option.description: option: all (fan-out to all ablecube hosts)

BearerAuth.name: Authorization
BearerAuth.description: Enter the token with the Bearer prefix, e.g. Bearer eyJ...
